What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Rescue In The Clouds (V)]]: left, the image of [[Rescue In The Clouds (V) (Errata)]] (holotable commit 35aa2a6); right, the image of [[Rescue In The Clouds (V) (Errata 2)]] (holotable commit 6489b69). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/35aa2a66de8c2b5feeb1ad348a3a240cdc9ffbef/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/rescueintheclouds.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/rescueintheclouds.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
